title: Load and display chat bubble button
description: Verify that the floating chat bubble button loads correctly on the landing page without UI glitches or errors.

steps.description: Open the website homepage in supported browsers.
Check that the floating chat bubble button is visible and positioned correctly.
Ensure no console errors or warnings related to chat bubble rendering.

title: Expand chat window on bubble click
description: Verify that clicking the chat bubble expands the chat window interface with text and voice input modes available.

steps.description: Click the floating chat bubble button.
Confirm that the chat window expands smoothly.
Confirm presence of text input box and microphone toggle.
Check that the chat window is responsive and the UI elements are functional.

title: Send text message and receive AI response
description: Verify sending a text message results in an AI-generated text response and audio playback within 3 seconds on average.

steps.description: Expand the chat window.
Type a valid user message into the text input box.
Click the send button.
Check that a loading indicator appears promptly after sending.
Verify that AI-generated text response is displayed within 3 seconds.
Confirm that the corresponding AI-generated audio response is played automatically.

title: Start, stop, and send voice recording input
description: Verify voice recording starts, stops, and sends correctly with speech recognition converting input to text and receiving AI response.

steps.description: Expand the chat window.
Toggle to voice input mode.
Start recording voice message using the microphone toggle.
Stop recording after a valid voice input.
Verify the speech recognition converts the audio to text accurately.
Send the voice input message.
Confirm AI response text and audio are received and displayed/played automatically.

title: Verify webhook response format and integration
description: Ensure HTTP POST requests to configured n8n webhook endpoint return valid JSON including 'text' and 'audio_url' fields.

steps.description: Send a valid input message or voice transcription to the n8n webhook via HTTP POST.
Verify the webhook response is a valid JSON object.
Check that response contains both 'text' and 'audio_url' fields.
Confirm 'text' is a non-empty string and 'audio_url' is a valid URL.

title: Validate AI response quality and relevance
description: Verify AI text responses are relevant to user input, professional in tone, context-aware, and concise (~100 words).

steps.description: Send a variety of typical user queries covering different conversational contexts.
Manually review AI text responses for relevance and appropriateness.
Ensure response length is concise and captures key information within about 100 words.
Check for professional tone and absence of irrelevant or inappropriate content.

title: Verify API key security and rate limiting
description: Ensure requests require valid API key; invalid or missing keys are rejected, and rate limiting prevents abuse.

steps.description: Send API request with valid API key.
Verify the request is accepted and processed successfully.
Send API request with invalid or missing API key.
Confirm the request is rejected with appropriate error message/status.
Rapidly send multiple valid requests to exceed rate limit.
Verify that rate limiting is enforced and further requests are rejected with rate limit error.

title: Validate secure communication protocols (HTTPS enforcement)
description: Ensure all API and webhook communications are only accepted over HTTPS connections and HTTP is blocked or redirected.

steps.description: Attempt to send API/webhook requests over HTTP.
Verify requests are rejected or redirected to HTTPS.
Send requests over HTTPS.
Verify requests are accepted and processed successfully.

title: Test CORS restrictions for security
description: Verify that the chat widget enforces CORS policies restricting requests only from authorized domains.

steps.description: Send cross-origin request from an authorized domain.
Confirm the request is accepted by the server.
Send cross-origin request from an unauthorized domain.
Verify the request is blocked by CORS policy.

title: Validate input sanitization and handling of invalid inputs
description: Ensure the system correctly handles empty, malformed, or malicious input data without breaking or exposing vulnerabilities.

steps.description: Send empty text message input.
Confirm input is rejected with validation error and no processing occurs.
Send malformed or excessively long text input.
Verify input is sanitized or rejected appropriately without system crashes.
Send inputs containing script tags or potential XSS attacks.
Confirm input is sanitized to prevent XSS and safe rendering in UI.

title: Test local testing tools functionality
description: Verify command-line webhook tester and local UI testing server operate correctly and allow development debugging.

steps.description: Run command-line webhook tester with a sample message input.
Verify webhook tester successfully sends and receives correct responses.
Start local UI testing server.
Confirm chat widget UI loads and operates as expected in local environment.
Test interactive features including text and voice chat functionality locally.

title: Validate voice playback configuration and multiple voice options
description: Test that MiniMax TTS audio responses play automatically and correspond to selected configurable voice options.

steps.description: Send input triggering AI response.
Verify audio playback starts automatically.
Change TTS voice option to an alternate voice setting.
Send another input triggering AI response.
Verify audio playback matches the changed voice configuration.

title: Verify user experience consistency across devices and browsers
description: Ensure the chat widget user experience, UI layout, and functionality are consistent and responsive across supported browsers and device types, including mobile.

steps.description: Open the chat widget on desktop browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
Verify UI elements render correctly and interactions work as expected.
Open the chat widget on mobile devices and responsive simulation.
Confirm layout adjusts appropriately to different screen sizes.
Test all input modes and features function correctly on all devices tested.

title: Test error handling on webhook failure
description: Simulate webhook endpoint failures or timeouts and verify graceful error handling and user notifications in the chat interface.

steps.description: Send a chat input causing webhook endpoint to return error or timeout.
Verify chat widget shows appropriate error message to the user.
Confirm system does not crash and allows user to retry or continue conversation.

title: Test documentation completeness for setup and troubleshooting
description: Verify that the provided setup and troubleshooting guides enable a new user to configure, deploy and debug the chat widget successfully.

steps.description: Follow the quick start guide to set up the chat widget in a test environment.
Confirm all configuration steps can be completed without issues.
Use troubleshooting guide to diagnose and fix simulated common issues.
Verify troubleshooting instructions effectively help resolve issues.
